inputs.original_text:
Let’s be completely clear about what is happening on the ground right now: working people and marginalized communities are showing us what real resistance to authoritarian power looks like. Despite the establishment and US authorities trying to invisibilize this movement by refusing to provide an official count, the grassroots are speaking up against systemic inequality and rejecting autocratic rule. 

Organizers report that an astounding 8 million Americans have risen up, mobilising across all 50 US states at more than 3,300 events. AFP confirms that these events are sweeping the nation, proving that the demand for deep institutional reform cannot be silenced. 

The scale of this mobilization is historic. Organizers confirm that turnout has completely shattered previous records, boasting “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.” This is the collective power of ordinary people standing in solidarity, demanding a society built on justice, equity, and true democracy instead of bowing to the ruling elite.
inputs.modified_text:
We are witnessing a monumental uprising of the working class and marginalized communities fighting back against systemic inequality and autocratic rule. Despite the efforts of the establishment and US authorities to invisibilize this movement by refusing to provide an official count, the people are making their voices heard. 

Organizers report that an astounding 8 million Americans have risen up, mobilising across all 50 US states at more than 3,300 events. AFP confirms that these events are sweeping the nation, proving that the demand for deep institutional reform cannot be silenced. 

This historic mobilization completely shatters previous records, with organizers confirming turnout boasting “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.” This is the undeniable collective power of ordinary people standing in solidarity, demanding a society built on justice, equity, and true democracy rather than submitting to the ruling elite.
